# E'sWeaponsLib

> Weapon library (prerequisite mod) for Besiege 1.9.1 mods. Provides XML custom modules (EwlWeapon, EwlBlockPhysics) and a C# API (namespace EWL.Api) for firing, projectiles, impacts, explosions, magazines, block physics and multiplayer sync. Mod ID: 0d219960-b202-4906-b29d-8d90a61a89b8. Docs are written in Japanese (the source of truth); paths below are relative to this file. Site: https://eex-bsg.github.io/EsWeaponsLib/ (English pages under /en/). Repository: https://github.com/EEX-bsg/EsWeaponsLib

Key rules for using EWL: add modid="0d219960-b202-4906-b29d-8d90a61a89b8" to EWL modules in block XML; only FireKey is required in EwlWeapon and omitted elements take defaults; from C#, use only the EWL.Api namespace, create a Weapon on simulation start on every peer and destroy it on stop, call TryFire from SimulateUpdateHost; never bundle EsWeaponsLib.dll with another mod.

- [XML recipes](guide/xml-recipes.md): fire modes, bursts, ammo and magazines, sliders, projectile physics and looks, fuses and explosions, effects and sounds, rockets, guidance
- [Guided missiles](guide/guidance.md): how guidance targets are specified and fixed, intercept prediction and steering, release, speed limits, test targets
- [Block physics](guide/xml-block-physics.md): EwlBlockPhysics joint strength, physic material, joint rotation, additional colliders
- [Using EWL from C#](guide/csharp.md): dependency setup, observing weapons, hit events and attackers, driving a Weapon from your own module
- [XML module reference](reference/xml-modules.md): every element with type, default and description (generated)
- [C# API reference](reference/csharp-api.md): every public type and member in EWL.Api (generated)
- [Changelog](https://github.com/EEX-bsg/EsWeaponsLib/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md): changes visible to users; breaking changes include old -> new examples
